description: Only telescopes whose bandwidth usage is strictly greater than 47.6 are included.

d.request: Join telescopes to matching observatories on `observstation`, keep telescopes with `bandusagepct > 47.6`, count them by observatory station and `lunarstage`, and return the 10 groups with the highest counts, showing the station, moon phase, and count.
d.sql: SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;

c.request: Matching each telescope to its observatory by `observstation` (dropping telescopes with no matching observatory) and keeping only telescopes on the high side of a 47.6 cutoff for bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`), count the telescopes for each combination of observatory station and moon phase (`lunarstage`). List the station, the moon phase and the count, ordered by count from highest to lowest, and show only the top 10. Only telescopes whose bandwidth usage is strictly greater than 47.6 are included.
c.sql: SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10
